name: shruti-gupta-editorial
direction: quiet editorial magazine — print-calm, serif display, the site itself is a writing sample
elevation: none — flat print aesthetic; depth via hairline rules + tinted panels only, no shadows

motion.principle: restrained — fades, rises, rule-draws; no bounces, no parallax soup

imagery.grammar: editorial still-life photography: desk, paper, print, warm side-light, muted warm palette matching paper/accent; NO glossy 3D, NO neon, NO stock-handshake
imagery.promptSuffix: editorial still-life photograph, warm off-white and oxblood palette, soft natural side light, quiet magazine aesthetic, matte, film grain, negative space
imagery.portraitMode: real cutout portraits of Shruti (user-asset) set on paper/tint panels — never floating in void
